prompts.prompt: Wide shot of about twenty people gathered on the stone steps outside Kulturhuset in central Stockholm on an overcast afternoon, natural daylight, a woman in a yellow scarf gesturing as she addresses the crowd during a neighborhood meetup.

Medium shot of an elderly woman with silver hair and glasses reading aloud from a picture book to a circle of attentive children seated cross-legged on the carpeted floor of a Stockholm public library, warm natural light filtering through tall windows.

Environmental portrait of a man in his forties wearing a denim apron helping a teenage girl arrange ceramic pots on a wooden shelf inside a community workshop at Konstverkstan, soft afternoon light from a skylight illuminating the cluttered, lived-in studio space.

Close-up of weathered hands passing a steaming cup of glögg across a worn wooden table at an outdoor Christmas community market in Skansen, shallow depth of field, late afternoon golden light catching the steam rising between strangers sharing a moment.
